name: Maps
tagline: Finds places and plans routes on OpenStreetMap

offers.label: Forget the places a search found
offers.description: Marks every place a search found as no longer found, and forgets the ones nobody kept.

offers.label: Remember a search
offers.description: Remembers a search, newest first, at most eight.

offers.label: Search maps
offers.description: Searches the map for the places `query` names, and shows what it found.

offers.label: Clear search
offers.description: Takes the last search's results away.

offers.label: Clear search history
offers.description: Takes the searches the person made away.

offers.label: Show the directions
offers.description: Opens the directions beside the map.

offers.label: Directions
offers.description: Opens or closes the directions beside the map, as its own row's toggle asks.

offers.label: Open place
offers.description: Shows the place `place` on the map: the map opens on it.

offers.label: Show a point on the map
offers.description: Shows a point on the map, as a link or another app names it.

offers.label: Use my location
offers.description: Finds the device and shows where it is.

offers.label: Zoom the map
offers.description: Zooms the map a level in or out: a level of imagery is the camera's zoom doubled or halved.

offers.label: Set transit time
offers.description: When public transport journeys leave, or when they must arrive.

offers.label: Get directions
offers.description: Plans a route between two places the person named, by the mode directions travel, and shows it.

offers.label: Another route
offers.description: Shows the next route directions offered for the same journey.

offers.label: Fit the map
offers.description: Shows everything the map holds: the route it draws, or every place it knows.

offers.label: Clear route
offers.description: Takes the route away.

offers.label: Another journey
offers.description: Shows the next journey public transport offered.

offers.label: Clear transit routes
offers.description: Takes the transit journeys away.

offers.label: Start navigation
offers.description: Follows the route the map draws: the live card says the turn ahead.

offers.label: End navigation
offers.description: Stops following the route.

offers.label: What is nearby
offers.description: Shows what stands around the map, from OpenStreetMap.

offers.label: Open place of interest
offers.description: Shows a point of interest the map found, and opens the map on it.

offers.label: Download this view
offers.description: Saves what the map shows for offline use: the box on screen and the zoom levels whose tiles it

offers.label: Download place
offers.description: Saves the area around the place `query` names for offline use, with the zoom levels whose tiles

offers.label: Stop downloading
offers.description: Stops an area's download: the tiles kept so far stay available offline.

offers.label: Download it again
offers.description: Starts a stopped area's download again, keeping what it already has.

offers.label: Delete offline area
offers.description: Takes an area this device saved away, and the tiles of it no other kept area needs.

offers.label: Clear offline maps
offers.description: Takes every area this device saved away.

offers.label: Open link
offers.description: Opens a `geo:` link: its search (`geo:0,0?q=cafe`), else its point (`geo:52.52,13.40`).
